title: Restart the sound server when audio is stuck
summary: If sound froze or stopped working, check the PipeWire and WirePlumber services that run for your user and restart them. This fixes the sound system without rebooting the computer.
prerequisites: Log in to your own desktop account, not as root
On Fedora the pipewire-pulse service is installed by the pipewire-pulseaudio package

steps.explain: Check that the PipeWire and WirePlumber services are running for your user. Look for 'Active: active (running)' on each one; 'failed' or 'inactive (dead)' means the service stopped. Press q if the output waits for you.
steps.expect: Both units show 'Active: active (running)'. This command changes nothing.

steps.explain: Restart PipeWire, its PulseAudio-compatible service and WirePlumber. Only your audio services restart; running programs stay open, but sound may stop for a few seconds.
steps.expect: No output if it worked. Sound returns within a few seconds.

verify.expect: Both units show 'Active: active (running)' with a recent start time.
